hints: 50% is the same as one half.
To find half of a number, divide it by 2.

solution.methodName: Change the percent to an easy fraction

steps.why: 50 out of 100 is the same as 1 out of 2.

steps.action: Find half of 80 by dividing by 2: 80 ÷ 2 = 40.
steps.why: 1/2 means 2 equal parts, and you take 1 of them.

trapNotes.8: This divides by 10, which gives 10% of 80. For 50%, divide by 2.
trapNotes.30: This subtracts 50 from 80. 50% of a number means half of it, so divide by 2.
trapNotes.160: This multiplies 80 by 2. Half of a number is smaller than the number, so divide by 2.
